🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND and HYG/LQD showing CREDIT STRESS ↑ (Credit Spread Level: 0.7322 | 1W: +1.21% | 1M: +0.94% ↑ rising) confirm risk aversion.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -1.54%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -1.95%) BELOW TREND; Fear elevated on the month: VXX (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%) CORRECTION showing shorter-term pullback but sustained monthly fear. Dollar strength rising (Level: 27.89 | 1W: +1.57% | 1M: +3.99% ↑ rising) tightens conditions.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tight: TLT (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND and yield curve falling (Level: 1.0483 ↓ falling) point to tighter financial conditions, while broad credit stress is rising.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities showing shelter: XLU (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +5.80%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -4.32%) BELOW TREND; style mixed with no clear broad leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US under pressure: SPY (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND; EM weak: EEM (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND while China FXI (1W: +1.17% | 1M: -8.18%) RECOVERY showing localized bounce.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation cooling: IWM (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -0.87%) BELOW TREND, but crypto strength in spot bitcoin IBIT (1W: +4.59% | 1M: +5.43%) ABOVE TREND provides selective risk exposure.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity bifurcation: Oil ETFs strong — USO (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +51.97%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +11.58% | 1M: +49.06%) ABOVE TREND — while industrials/metals weak with CPER (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -5.38%) BELOW TREND; gold GLD (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -1.45%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy favored: XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas mixed with UNG (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +2.60%) CORRECTION.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Weak breadth (2/11) and rising credit stress plus SPY BELOW TREND align with RISK-OFF. DIVERGENCE: VXX (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%) CORRECTION and FXI (1W: +1.17% | 1M: -8.18%) RECOVERY are short-term mismatches but not a major core-ETF divergence.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Reduce exposure to broad equity beta (SPY (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND, IWM (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND) and monitor credit; favor energy exposure (XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND) and selective liquid hedges.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND if oil momentum continues. BEARISH: XLF (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -9.44%) BELOW TREND and XLY (1W: -3.17% | 1M: -6.59%) BELOW TREND on credit sensitivity.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +11.58% | 1M: +49.06%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +51.97%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -5.38%) BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -1.45%) BELOW TREND if risk-off persists.

13. Key Levels?
VXX (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%) CORRECTION — watch 20 for complacency shift; Credit Spread ~0.73 (HYG/LQD signaling stress) — monitor for widening; XLK/XLF tech vs financials ratio ~2.80 (Tech still under pressure versus broader market dynamics).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; SPY (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND and rising credit stress (HYG/LQD) confirm defensive regime. Energy XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) and utilities XLU (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +5.80%) showing relative strength while VXX (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%) CORRECTION is the key divergence to monitor.
